structured_retry_limit=0 must yield single-shot behavior (zero output-repair retries and zero usage-limit addend) preserving the overlap/judge and contracts batch abstain fail-safe
Exactly one outer agent.run_sync invocation occurs on well-formed first response; exactly two (native then prompted) only on bug-895c downgrade; never a third
All bespoke fresh-Agent output-attempt loop and compatibility-delegation code must be removed, retaining only deterministic parsing and the runner facade
Existing provider fallback eligibility, tool limits, timeout/transport ownership, provenance, and serialized output shapes remain unchanged and verified by historical regression suites
